text: Our trial ended on September 2 and switched over to Starter on its own, but invoice INV-4471 lists 7 seats at $29 ($203) when we only ever invited 4 people, including Dana Whitlock. Could someone check where the other 3 seats came from? Also, why is the receipt in euros when we're in Portland and paid with a US card?

The checkout page kept saying "Payment could not be processed" when I tried to upgrade our trial to Team on September 10, but my bank shows two $588 charges for Lumen that afternoon. One of them needs to be refunded today because it's the company card and the controller, Owen Barrett, is already asking about it. It also feels like the checkout page itself is broken, since it never gave me a receipt or a confirmation.

Can you add our VAT number (GB 418 2267 03) to next month's invoice? Our accountant, Farah Nasser, won't pay anything that doesn't show it, and I can't find a box for it anywhere in settings. While I'm here, is there any real difference between paying monthly and paying annually besides the price?

Our trial ends Friday and I'm pretty sure it's about to charge us $4,788 for 12 seats on an annual Team plan, but we only need 5 seats and we're not ready to commit to a full year. Can you cancel the renewal before Friday, or at least move us to monthly? My cofounder, Tomás Reyes, has the only company card and he's in Lisbon until Tuesday, so I can't approve anything today.

The Visa ending 4412 that we put on file during signup expires at the end of September, and our annual renewal is set for October 3 for $590. The update-card button in billing settings just spins and never saves the new one. If that charge fails, we lose the dashboards in the middle of our quarter, so please help us get the new card in before Friday.

The Salesforce connector in our trial workspace has said "Syncing 42,318 records" for four days, and not a single one has shown up in Lumen. I also can't get into the workspace to check the connection settings, because it keeps bouncing me back to the two-factor screen even after I type the right code. Is the login loop connected to the connector being stuck, or are these two separate problems?

Our Postgres connector shows a green checkmark, but the dashboards still say no data for the public.orders table. It says it synced 3 minutes ago, and I know that table has about 18,000 rows. Does the query need to say something specific to find the data, or should it just appear once the connector is green? Nothing's broken, we just started the trial on Monday and I don't want to give up on it yet.

Our weekly revenue report was supposed to go to 14 people Monday at 8:00 AM, but nobody has gotten it for two weeks, even though the schedule page shows the next run is tomorrow. The delivery history just says "sent" for every run. Our board meeting is Wednesday morning and I need those numbers in their inboxes by then.

Our webhook endpoint (https://hooks.northstar-outdoor.com/lumen) started returning 502 errors on Monday, and Lumen gave up after 12 retries. Where do I see the delivery history, and can I resend the ones that failed? None of our 9 test orders since Monday have reached our fulfillment system yet, so I'd like to replay them before we wipe the test data.

On our trial, the REST API starts returning 429 errors after about 20 requests in a minute, but the API docs say the limit is 100 per minute. Our nightly job only does 300 calls total, so I'm not sure if something's wrong on our end or if trials just get a smaller allowance. If trials are capped, what plan would we need so the job can finish without timing out?

The person who started our trial, Marcus Feld, left the company last Friday, and he's still listed as the owner of the Redwood Analytics workspace. I need to invite three more people from my team before our trial ends on the 19th. Can ownership be moved to me (jordan.ellis@redwood-analytics.com)?

Where do I change my profile picture and the name people see on my comments in dashboards? Everyone on my team still sees me as "jellis" from when we signed up. Also, if I change my email in Lumen, does that change it for my login too, or just for notifications?

I was added to the "Q3 Pipeline" workspace as a viewer, but I can't edit any of the dashboards, even the ones I built. My manager says I need the editor role, but I'm not sure what the difference is between viewer, editor, and admin. Who do I ask to change it, the owner or an admin?

Our workspace says 4 of 5 trial seats are used, but I only invited 3 people, and it won't let me remove anyone because I'm not an admin. One of the names in the list is s.chen@brightpath.io, and nobody here recognizes that address. Can you find out who has that seat, and does it count against us if we upgrade?

I turned on 2FA for my account last Thursday and now I'm locked out after switching to a new phone. Our workspace owner, Priya Natarajan, is at a conference until Monday, and the recovery screen just says to contact the owner. Can you help me get back in or reset my 2FA?

Our parent company just approved a 30% budget increase, and we need 40 seats live by October 1 or the rollout gets pushed a full quarter. Can you send a quote for 40 seats on Team today, with annual billing and SSO included? Procurement also needs a W-9 and your bank details for an ACH transfer before they'll issue the PO.

If we move from the 5 seats we have now to 25 seats partway through the year, do we pay the full price for all 25 or only part of the year for the extra 20? Our CFO, Daniel Cho, wants to know before he approves anything, and I couldn't make sense of the calculator on the pricing page. He'd also like to see the numbers for monthly versus annual before Friday.

I'd like to switch from the trial to a paid plan before it ends on the 30th, but the Starter page says 3 seats while we have 5 people using it, and I can't tell if we'd have to pay for all 5 right away. Also, can you delete the test workspace we made for our hackathon, or does that get billed too? Whichever plan fits 5 people, just send me the link.

Can you walk me through the difference between Team and Enterprise? We'll be around 60 people by January and I don't understand what SSO or workspaces actually get us. A 20-minute call with our ops lead, Hana Sato, would help, ideally early next week.

What's the price difference between monthly and annual billing for the Team plan? We'd be 12 people if we upgraded before the trial ends. Also, is there a discount for nonprofits? We're a small conservation group called Tidewater Trust.

I'm with Kestrel & Co., a data consultancy in Leeds, and we'd love to refer clients to Lumen since they keep asking for something like it. Is there a partner or referral program? We're using the trial ourselves right now and so far the Shopify connector has been our favorite part.

Urgent: someone has gotten into our workspace. I'm seeing logins from an IP in Kyiv, a new user called "Lumen Support Bot" was added as an admin, and the login history shows 23 failed 2FA attempts overnight. Please lock the Meridian Health workspace now, because it has patient counts in it. I already changed my password, but I can't remove the other user since I'm not the owner, and the owner, Grace Liu, is offline.

I've been testing Lumen for a week for an article on analytics pricing in TechLedger Monthly. The terminology tripped me up a bit at first, especially seats versus workspaces. For the piece, could someone confirm whether dashboards shared through a public link count toward a seat?

Just wanted to say the BigQuery connector took about four minutes to set up, which is faster than any tool we've tried. The rest has been a little confusing (I still don't know what a "schedule" does versus a "report"), but that part was painless. No question, just thought you should know.

I applied for the data analyst job on your careers page two weeks ago and haven't heard anything back. Is there someone I can follow up with? I've been on the trial at my current job, Northwind Grocers, for about ten days and have gotten pretty comfortable with the connectors.
